name: Raon-SpeechChat-9B
access: Hugging Face weights (KRAFTON/Raon-SpeechChat-9B, Transformers with trust_remote_code)

voice.voices: 17 built-in personas with customisable system prompts; optional reference audio for voice cloning through ECAPA-TDNN speaker embeddings [raon-card-chat]
languages: English (the SpeechChat card); the base Raon-Speech model covers English and Korean
voice.turn_detection: None to configure; the model decodes listening and speaking at once. A dedicated backchannel token produces short feedback such as uh-huh, and a backchannel penalty adjusts how often; runtime token forcing selects speak-first or listen-first mode [raon-card-chat]
voice.interruption: Built into the model: the card lists natural turn-taking, backchannels and barge-in handling; no separate setting was found [raon-card-chat]
voice.latency: Artificial Analysis lists 0.04 seconds to first audio on its Big Bench Audio set; the page does not say how this is measured for a model that can speak while it listens [aa-s2s]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights under a non-commercial licence, with no hosted price. The self-hosted demo asks for an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 12 and 16 GB or more of memory, and downloads about 25 GB of model files on first run [raon-card-chat]
